dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent circular and C-shaped light-toned perimeters with soft gradient transitions from dark charcoal exterior to lighter gray interior, most distinct on the mid-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of clustered light-intensity pixels forming ring-like structures; core concentrations are highest along the dorsal midline and upper flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Triangular arrangement formed by the centroids of three primary annuli on the upper right lateral side, with a secondary linear chain of smaller ring centroids extending towards the posterior.
